prompt.text: Which store keeps key-value strings until they are deleted?

hints: Its name suggests it lasts on this device.
cards.fullLine: localStorage keeps key-value strings until they are deleted.

teaching.text: It survives reloads and browser restarts until something removes the entry.

answer.text: sessionStorage is cleared when the tab closes.

hints: It lasts as long as one browsing context.
cards.fullLine: sessionStorage is cleared when the tab closes.

teaching.text: Each browsing context gets its own copy, and closing it discards the data.

prompt.text: Which store is best for thousands of structured records?

hints: It has an index and a database in its name.
cards.fullLine: IndexedDB is best for thousands of structured records.

teaching.text: It holds many structured records and can be searched by key.

prompt.text: Cookies are sent to the server with

answer.text: Cookies are sent to the server with every request to the same origin.

cards.fullLine: Cookies are sent to the server with every request to the same origin.

teaching.text: They travel with the request, so keep them small.

prompt.text: Which store takes only strings, so objects must be converted with JSON?

hints: Its sibling for one session behaves the same way.
cards.fullLine: localStorage takes only strings, so objects must be converted with JSON.

teaching.text: Values come back as text, so objects need JSON in and out.

prompt.text: Which storage does a service worker's fetch handling read from?

hints: It holds whole responses, not single values.
cards.fullLine: A service worker's fetch handling reads from Cache Storage.

prompt.text: Scripts reach Cache Storage through the

answer.text: Scripts reach Cache Storage through the caches API.

hints: The global object is named after what it holds.
cards.fullLine: Scripts reach Cache Storage through the caches API.

prompt.text: Which store survives a reload but not a new tab?

hints: Think of one sitting in one window.
cards.fullLine: sessionStorage survives a reload but not a new tab.

hints: Numbers and objects must be converted first.

teaching.text: Numbers and objects must be converted before they are stored.

prompt.text: Two pages share storage only when they share which three parts?

hints: A path is not one of them.
cards.fullLine: Two pages share storage only when they share scheme, host and port.

teaching.text: A path or a query string does not change which pages share a store.
